verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּשִׂ֖ים לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh ham·miš·pā·ṭîm ’ă·šer tā·śîm lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: These are the ordinances that you are to set before them
verses.literalPt: ESTES são os estatutos que lhes proporás.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תִקְנֶה֙ עֶ֣בֶד עִבְרִ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים יַעֲבֹ֑ד וּבַ֨שְּׁבִעִ֔ת יֵצֵ֥א לַֽחָפְשִׁ֖י חִנָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯiq·neh ‘e·ḇeḏ ‘iḇ·rî šêš šā·nîm ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ ū·ḇaš·šə·ḇi·‘iṯ yê·ṣê la·ḥā·p̄ə·šî ḥin·nām
verses.literal: If you buy a Hebrew servant he is to serve you for six years But in the seventh year he shall go free without paying anything
verses.literalPt: Se comprares um servo hebreu, seis anos servirá; mas ao sétimo sairá livre, de graça.

verses.original: אִם־ בְּגַפּ֥וֹ יָבֹ֖א בְּגַפּ֣וֹ יֵצֵ֑א אִם־ בַּ֤עַל אִשָּׁה֙ ה֔וּא וְיָצְאָ֥ה אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- bə·ḡap·pōw yā·ḇō bə·ḡap·pōw yê·ṣê ’im- ba·‘al ’iš·šāh hū wə·yā·ṣə·’āh ’iš·tōw ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: If he arrived alone . . . he is to leave alone . . . if . . . he arrived with a wife she is to leave with him
verses.literalPt: Se entrou só com o seu corpo, só com o seu corpo sairá; se ele era homem casado, sua mulher sairá com ele.

verses.original: אִם־ אֲדֹנָיו֙ יִתֶּן־ ל֣וֹ אִשָּׁ֔ה וְיָלְדָה־ ל֥וֹ בָנִ֖ים א֣וֹ בָנ֑וֹת הָאִשָּׁ֣ה וִילָדֶ֗יהָ תִּהְיֶה֙ לַֽאדֹנֶ֔יהָ וְה֖וּא יֵצֵ֥א בְגַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ă·ḏō·nāw yit·ten- lōw ’iš·šāh wə·yā·lə·ḏāh- lōw ḇā·nîm ’ōw ḇā·nō·wṯ hā·’iš·šāh wî·lā·ḏe·hā tih·yeh la·ḏō·ne·hā wə·hū yê·ṣê ḇə·ḡap·pōw
verses.literal: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters the woman and her children shall belong to her master and only the man shall go free . . .
verses.literalPt: Se seu senhor lhe houver dado uma mulher e ela lhe houver dado filhos ou filhas, a mulher e seus filhos serão de seu senhor, e ele sairá sozinho.

verses.original: וְאִם־ אָמֹ֤ר יֹאמַר֙ הָעֶ֔בֶד אָהַ֙בְתִּי֙ אֶת־ אֲדֹנִ֔י אֶת־ אִשְׁתִּ֖י וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֑י לֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א חָפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ā·mōr yō·mar hā·‘e·ḇeḏ ’ā·haḇ·tî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nî ’eṯ- ’iš·tî wə·’eṯ- bā·nāy lō ’ê·ṣê ḥā·p̄ə·šî
verses.literal: But if the servant declares . . . I love my master and my wife and children I do not want to go free
verses.literalPt: Mas se aquele servo expressamente disser: Eu amo a meu senhor, e a minha mulher, e a meus filhos; não quero sair livre,

verses.original: וְהִגִּישׁ֤וֹ אֲדֹנָיו֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְהִגִּישׁוֹ֙ אֶל־ הַדֶּ֔לֶת א֖וֹ אֶל־ הַמְּזוּזָ֑ה וְרָצַ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֤יו אֶת־ אָזְנוֹ֙ בַּמַּרְצֵ֔עַ וַעֲבָד֖וֹ לְעֹלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hig·gî·šōw ’ă·ḏō·nāw ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·hig·gî·šōw ’el- had·de·leṯ ’ōw ’el- ham·mə·zū·zāh wə·rā·ṣa‘ ’ă·ḏō·nāw ’eṯ- ’ā·zə·nōw bam·mar·ṣê·a‘ wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏōw lə·‘ō·lām
verses.literal: then his master is to bring him before the judges And he shall take him to the door or . . . doorpost - and pierce his ear with an awl Then he shall serve his master for life
verses.literalPt: Então seu SENHOR o levará aos juízes, e o fará chegar à porta, ou ao umbral da porta, e seu senhor lhe furará a orelha com uma sovela; e ele o servirá para sempre.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִמְכֹּ֥ר אִ֛ישׁ אֶת־ בִּתּ֖וֹ לְאָמָ֑ה לֹ֥א תֵצֵ֖א כְּצֵ֥את הָעֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yim·kōr ’îš ’eṯ- bit·tōw lə·’ā·māh lō ṯê·ṣê kə·ṣêṯ hā·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm
verses.literal: And if a man sells his daughter as a servant she is not to go free . . . as the menservants do
verses.literalPt: E se um homem vender sua filha para ser serva, ela não sairá como saem os servos.

verses.original: אִם־ רָעָ֞ה בְּעֵינֵ֧י אֲדֹנֶ֛יהָ אֲשֶׁר־ לֹא יְעָדָ֖הּ וְהֶפְדָּ֑הּ לְעַ֥ם נָכְרִ֛י לֹא־ יִמְשֹׁ֥ל לְמָכְרָ֖הּ בְּבִגְדוֹ־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- rā·‘āh bə·‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·ne·hā ’ă·šer- lō yə·‘ā·ḏāh wə·hep̄·dāh lə·‘am nā·ḵə·rî lō- yim·šōl lə·mā·ḵə·rāh bə·ḇiḡ·ḏōw- ḇāh
verses.literal: If she is displeasing in the eyes of her master who had designated her for himself he must allow her to be redeemed He has no right to sell her to foreigners . . . . . . since he has broken faith with her
verses.literalPt: Se ela não agradar ao seu SENHOR, e ele não se desposar com ela, fará que se resgate; não poderá vendê-la a um povo estranho, agindo deslealmente com ela.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לִבְנ֖וֹ יִֽיעָדֶ֑נָּה כְּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַבָּנ֖וֹת יַעֲשֶׂה־ לָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- liḇ·nōw yî·‘ā·ḏen·nāh kə·miš·paṭ hab·bā·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·śeh- lāh
verses.literal: And if he chooses her for his son he must deal with her as with a daughter
verses.literalPt: Mas se a desposar com seu filho, fará com ela conforme ao direito das filhas.

verses.original: אִם־ אַחֶ֖רֶת יִֽקַּֽח־ ל֑וֹ שְׁאֵרָ֛הּ כְּסוּתָ֥הּ וְעֹנָתָ֖הּ לֹ֥א יִגְרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’a·ḥe·reṯ yiq·qaḥ- lōw šə·’ê·rāh kə·sū·ṯāh wə·‘ō·nā·ṯāh lō yiḡ·rā‘
verses.literal: If he takes another wife he must not reduce the food clothing or marital rights of his first wife
verses.literalPt: Se lhe tomar outra, não diminuirá o mantimento desta, nem o seu vestido, nem a sua obrigação marital.

verses.original: וְאִם־ שְׁלָ֨שׁ־ אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לָ֑הּ וְיָצְאָ֥ה חִנָּ֖ם אֵ֥ין כָּֽסֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- šə·lāš- ’êl·leh lō ya·‘ă·śeh lāh wə·yā·ṣə·’āh ḥin·nām ’ên kā·sep̄
verses.literal: If, however he does not provide her with these three things she is free to go . . . without monetary payment
verses.literalPt: E se lhe não fizer estas três coisas, sairá de graça, sem dar dinheiro.

verses.original: מַכֵּ֥ה אִ֛ישׁ וָמֵ֖ת מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: mak·kêh ’îš wā·mêṯ mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Whoever strikes and kills a man must surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: Quem ferir alguém, de modo que este morra, certamente será morto.

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א צָדָ֔ה וְהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אִנָּ֣ה לְיָד֑וֹ וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י לְךָ֙ מָק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנ֖וּס שָֽׁמָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·šer lō ṣā·ḏāh wə·hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’in·nāh lə·yā·ḏōw wə·śam·tî lə·ḵā mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yā·nūs šām·māh
verses.literal: If, however he did not lie in wait but God allowed it to happen . . . then I will appoint for you a place where he may flee . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém se lhe não armou cilada, mas Deus lho entregou nas mãos, ordenar-te-ei um lugar para onde fugirá.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יָזִ֥ד אִ֛ישׁ עַל־ רֵעֵ֖הוּ לְהָרְג֣וֹ בְעָרְמָ֑ה מֵעִ֣ם מִזְבְּחִ֔י תִּקָּחֶ֖נּוּ לָמֽוּת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yā·ziḏ ’îš ‘al- rê·‘ê·hū lə·hā·rə·ḡōw ḇə·‘ā·rə·māh mê·‘im miz·bə·ḥî tiq·qā·ḥen·nū lā·mūṯ
verses.literal: But if a man schemes and acts willfully against his neighbor to kill him you must take him away from My altar to be put to death
verses.literalPt: Mas se alguém agir premeditadamente contra o seu próximo, matando-o à traição, tirá-lo-ás do meu altar, para que morra.

verses.original: וּמַכֵּ֥ה אָבִ֛יו וְאִמּ֖וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mak·kêh ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Whoever strikes his father or mother must surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: O que ferir a seu pai, ou a sua mãe, certamente será morto.

verses.original: וְגֹנֵ֨ב אִ֧ישׁ וּמְכָר֛וֹ וְנִמְצָ֥א בְיָד֖וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡō·nêḇ ’îš ū·mə·ḵā·rōw wə·nim·ṣā ḇə·yā·ḏōw mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Whoever kidnaps another man must be put to death . . . whether he sells him or the man is found in his possession
verses.literalPt: E quem raptar um homem, e o vender, ou for achado na sua mão, certamente será morto.

verses.original: וּמְקַלֵּ֥ל אָבִ֛יו וְאִמּ֖וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mə·qal·lêl ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Anyone who curses his father or mother must surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: E quem amaldiçoar a seu pai ou a sua mãe, certamente será morto.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יְרִיבֻ֣ן אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְהִכָּה־ אִישׁ֙ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֔הוּ בְּאֶ֖בֶן א֣וֹ בְאֶגְרֹ֑ף וְלֹ֥א יָמ֖וּת וְנָפַ֥ל לְמִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yə·rî·ḇun ’ă·nā·šîm wə·hik·kāh- ’îš ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū bə·’e·ḇen ’ōw ḇə·’eḡ·rōp̄ wə·lō yā·mūṯ wə·nā·p̄al lə·miš·kāḇ
verses.literal: If men are quarreling and one strikes the other with a stone or a fist and he does not die but is confined to bed
verses.literalPt: E se dois homens pelejarem, ferindo-se um ao outro com pedra ou com o punho, e este não morrer, mas cair na cama,

verses.original: אִם־ יָק֞וּם וְהִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּח֛וּץ עַל־ מִשְׁעַנְתּ֖וֹ וְנִקָּ֣ה הַמַּכֶּ֑ה רַ֥ק שִׁבְתּ֛וֹ יִתֵּ֖ן וְרַפֹּ֥א יְרַפֵּֽא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im- yā·qūm wə·hiṯ·hal·lêḵ ba·ḥūṣ ‘al- miš·‘an·tōw wə·niq·qāh ham·mak·keh raq šiḇ·tōw yit·tên wə·rap·pō yə·rap·pê
verses.literal: then the one who struck him shall go unpunished as long as the other can get up and walk around outside with his staff Nevertheless he must compensate the man for his lost work and see that he is completely healed . . .
verses.literalPt: Se ele tornar a levantar-se e andar fora, sobre o seu bordão, então aquele que o feriu será absolvido; somente lhe pagará o tempo que perdera e o fará curar totalmente.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יַכֶּה֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶת־ עַבְדּ֜וֹ א֤וֹ אֶת־ אֲמָתוֹ֙ בַּשֵּׁ֔בֶט וּמֵ֖ת תַּ֣חַת יָד֑וֹ נָקֹ֖ם יִנָּקֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yak·keh ’îš ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·dōw ’ōw ’eṯ- ’ă·mā·ṯōw baš·šê·ḇeṭ ū·mêṯ ta·ḥaṯ yā·ḏōw nā·qōm yin·nā·qêm
verses.literal: If a man strikes his manservant or maidservant with a rod and the servant dies by his hand he shall surely be punished . . .
verses.literalPt: Se alguém ferir a seu servo, ou a sua serva, com pau, e morrer debaixo da sua mão, certamente será castigado;

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ אִם־ י֛וֹם א֥וֹ יוֹמַ֖יִם יַעֲמֹ֑ד לֹ֣א יֻקַּ֔ם כִּ֥י כַסְפּ֖וֹ הֽוּא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’im- yō·wm ’ōw yō·w·ma·yim ya·‘ă·mōḏ lō yuq·qam kî ḵas·pōw hū
verses.literal: However if the servant gets up after a day or two the owner shall not be punished since the servant is his property
verses.literalPt: Porém se sobreviver por um ou dois dias, não será castigado, porque é dinheiro seu.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִנָּצ֣וּ אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וְנָ֨גְפ֜וּ אִשָּׁ֤ה הָרָה֙ וְיָצְא֣וּ יְלָדֶ֔יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִהְיֶ֖ה אָס֑וֹן עָנ֣וֹשׁ יֵעָנֵ֗שׁ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָשִׁ֤ית עָלָיו֙ בַּ֣עַל הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וְנָתַ֖ן בִּפְלִלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yin·nā·ṣū ’ă·nā·šîm wə·nā·ḡə·p̄ū ’iš·šāh hā·rāh wə·yā·ṣə·’ū yə·lā·ḏe·hā wə·lō yih·yeh ’ā·sō·wn ‘ā·nō·wōš yê·‘ā·nêš ka·’ă·šer yā·šîṯ ‘ā·lāw ba·‘al hā·’iš·šāh wə·nā·ṯan bip̄·li·lîm
verses.literal: If men who are fighting strike a pregnant woman and her child is born prematurely but there is no further injury he shall surely be fined . . . as the woman’s husband demands and as the court allows . . .
verses.literalPt: Se alguns homens pelejarem, e um ferir uma mulher grávida, e for causa de que aborte, porém não havendo outro dano, certamente será multado, conforme o que lhe impuser o marido da mulher, e julgarem os juízes.

verses.original: וְאִם־ אָס֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֥ה נֶ֖פֶשׁ תַּ֥חַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ā·sō·wn yih·yeh wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ne·p̄eš ta·ḥaṯ nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: But if a serious injury results then you must require a life for a life
verses.literalPt: Mas se houver morte, então darás vida por vida,

verses.original: עַ֚יִן תַּ֣חַת עַ֔יִן שֵׁ֖ן תַּ֣חַת שֵׁ֑ן יָ֚ד תַּ֣חַת יָ֔ד רֶ֖גֶל תַּ֥חַת רָֽגֶל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘a·yin ta·ḥaṯ ‘a·yin šên ta·ḥaṯ šên yāḏ ta·ḥaṯ yāḏ re·ḡel ta·ḥaṯ rā·ḡel
verses.literal: eye for eye tooth for tooth hand for hand foot for foot
verses.literalPt: Olho por olho, dente por dente, mão por mão, pé por pé,

verses.original: כְּוִיָּה֙ תַּ֣חַת כְּוִיָּ֔ה פֶּ֖צַע תַּ֣חַת פָּ֑צַע חַבּוּרָ֕ה תַּ֖חַת חַבּוּרָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·wî·yāh ta·ḥaṯ kə·wî·yāh pe·ṣa‘ ta·ḥaṯ pā·ṣa‘ ḥab·bū·rāh ta·ḥaṯ ḥab·bū·rāh
verses.literal: burn for burn wound for wound and stripe for stripe
verses.literalPt: Queimadura por queimadura, ferida por ferida, golpe por golpe.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יַכֶּ֨ה אִ֜ישׁ אֶת־ עֵ֥ין עַבְדּ֛וֹ אֽוֹ־ אֶת־ עֵ֥ין אֲמָת֖וֹ וְשִֽׁחֲתָ֑הּ לַֽחָפְשִׁ֥י יְשַׁלְּחֶ֖נּוּ תַּ֥חַת עֵינֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yak·keh ’îš ’eṯ- ‘ên ‘aḇ·dōw ’ōw- ’eṯ- ‘ên ’ă·mā·ṯōw wə·ši·ḥă·ṯāh la·ḥā·p̄ə·šî yə·šal·lə·ḥen·nū ta·ḥaṯ ‘ê·nōw
verses.literal: If a man strikes and blinds the eye of his manservant or maidservant he must let the servant go free as compensation for . . . the eye
verses.literalPt: E quando alguém ferir o olho do seu servo, ou o olho da sua serva, e o danificar, o deixará ir livre pelo seu olho.

verses.original: וְאִם־ שֵׁ֥ן עַבְדּ֛וֹ אֽוֹ־ שֵׁ֥ן אֲמָת֖וֹ יַפִּ֑יל לַֽחָפְשִׁ֥י יְשַׁלְּחֶ֖נּוּ תַּ֥חַת שִׁנּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- šên ‘aḇ·dōw ’ōw- šên ’ă·mā·ṯōw yap·pîl la·ḥā·p̄ə·šî yə·šal·lə·ḥen·nū ta·ḥaṯ šin·nōw
verses.literal: And if he knocks out the tooth of his manservant or maidservant he must let the servant go free as compensation for . . . the tooth
verses.literalPt: E se tirar o dente do seu servo, ou o dente da sua serva, o deixará ir livre pelo seu dente.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִגַּ֨ח שׁ֥וֹר אֶת־ אִ֛ישׁ א֥וֹ אֶת־ אִשָּׁ֖ה וָמֵ֑ת סָק֨וֹל יִסָּקֵ֜ל הַשּׁ֗וֹר וְלֹ֤א יֵאָכֵל֙ אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֔וֹ וּבַ֥עַל הַשּׁ֖וֹר נָקִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yig·gaḥ šō·wr ’eṯ- ’îš ’ōw ’eṯ- ’iš·šāh wā·mêṯ sā·qō·wl yis·sā·qêl haš·šō·wr wə·lō yê·’ā·ḵêl ’eṯ- bə·śā·rōw ū·ḇa·‘al haš·šō·wr nā·qî
verses.literal: If an ox gores a man or woman to death the ox must surely be stoned . . . and its meat must not be eaten But the owner of the ox shall not be held responsible
verses.literalPt: E se algum boi escornear homem ou mulher, que morra, o boi será apedrejado certamente, e a sua carne não se comerá; mas o dono do boi será absolvido.

verses.original: וְאִ֡ם שׁוֹר֩ נַגָּ֨ח ה֜וּא מִתְּמֹ֣ל שִׁלְשֹׁ֗ם וְהוּעַ֤ד בִּבְעָלָיו֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמְרֶ֔נּוּ וְהֵמִ֥ית אִ֖ישׁ א֣וֹ אִשָּׁ֑ה הַשּׁוֹר֙ יִסָּקֵ֔ל וְגַם־ בְּעָלָ֖יו יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im šō·wr nag·gāḥ hū mit·tə·mōl šil·šōm wə·hū·‘aḏ biḇ·‘ā·lāw wə·lō yiš·mə·ren·nū wə·hê·mîṯ ’îš ’ōw ’iš·šāh haš·šō·wr yis·sā·qêl wə·ḡam- bə·‘ā·lāw yū·māṯ
verses.literal: But if the ox has a habit . . . of goring . . . and its owner has been warned yet does not restrain it and it kills a man or woman then the ox must be stoned and its owner must also be put to death
verses.literalPt: Mas se o boi dantes era escorneador, e o seu dono foi conhecedor disso, e não o guardou, matando homem ou mulher, o boi será apedrejado, e também o seu dono morrerá.

verses.original: אִם־ כֹּ֖פֶר יוּשַׁ֣ת עָלָ֑יו וְנָתַן֙ פִּדְיֹ֣ן נַפְשׁ֔וֹ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יוּשַׁ֖ת עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- kō·p̄er yū·šaṯ ‘ā·lāw wə·nā·ṯan piḏ·yōn nap̄·šōw kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yū·šaṯ ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: If payment is demanded of him instead he may redeem his life by paying the full amount demanded of him
verses.literalPt: Se lhe for imposto resgate, então dará por resgate da sua vida tudo quanto lhe for imposto,

verses.original: אוֹ־ בֵ֥ן יִגָּ֖ח אוֹ־ בַ֣ת יִגָּ֑ח כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט הַזֶּ֖ה יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- ḇên yig·gāḥ ’ōw- ḇaṯ yig·gāḥ kam·miš·pāṭ haz·zeh yê·‘ā·śeh lōw
verses.literal: If the ox gores a son or a daughter . . . it shall be done to him according to the same rule
verses.literalPt: Quer tenha escorneado um filho, quer tenha escorneado uma filha; conforme a este estatuto lhe será feito.

verses.original: אִם־ עֶ֛בֶד יִגַּ֥ח הַשּׁ֖וֹר א֣וֹ אָמָ֑ה כֶּ֣סֶף׀ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֗ים יִתֵּן֙ לַֽאדֹנָ֔יו וְהַשּׁ֖וֹר יִסָּקֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im- ‘e·ḇeḏ yig·gaḥ haš·šō·wr ’ōw ’ā·māh ke·sep̄ šə·lō·šîm šə·qā·lîm yit·tên la·ḏō·nāw wə·haš·šō·wr yis·sā·qêl
verses.literal: If the ox gores a manservant or maidservant the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of that servant and the ox must be stoned
verses.literalPt: Se o boi escornear um servo, ou uma serva, dar-se-á trinta siclos de prata ao seu senhor, e o boi será apedrejado.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִפְתַּ֨ח אִ֜ישׁ בּ֗וֹר א֠וֹ כִּֽי־ יִכְרֶ֥ה אִ֛ישׁ בֹּ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יְכַסֶּ֑נּוּ וְנָֽפַל־ שָׁ֥מָּה שּׁ֖וֹר א֥וֹ חֲמֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yip̄·taḥ ’îš bō·wr ’ōw kî- yiḵ·reh ’îš bōr wə·lō yə·ḵas·sen·nū wə·nā·p̄al- šām·māh šō·wr ’ōw ḥă·mō·wr
verses.literal: If a man opens or . . . digs . . . a pit and fails to cover it and an ox or a donkey falls into it
verses.literalPt: Se alguém abrir uma cova, ou se alguém cavar uma cova, e não a cobrir, e nela cair um boi ou um jumento,

verses.original: בַּ֤עַל הַבּוֹר֙ יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם כֶּ֖סֶף יָשִׁ֣יב לִבְעָלָ֑יו וְהַמֵּ֖ת יִֽהְיֶה־ לּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ba·‘al hab·bō·wr yə·šal·lêm ke·sep̄ yā·šîḇ liḇ·‘ā·lāw wə·ham·mêṯ yih·yeh- lōw
verses.literal: the owner of the pit shall make restitution he must pay . . . its owner and the dead animal will be his
verses.literalPt: O dono da cova o pagará; pagará em dinheiro ao seu dono, mas o animal morto será seu.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִגֹּ֧ף שֽׁוֹר־ אִ֛ישׁ אֶת־ שׁ֥וֹר רֵעֵ֖הוּ וָמֵ֑ת וּמָ֨כְר֜וּ אֶת־ הַשּׁ֤וֹר הַחַי֙ וְחָצ֣וּ אֶת־ כַּסְפּ֔וֹ וְגַ֥ם אֶת־ הַמֵּ֖ת יֶֽחֱצֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yig·gōp̄ šō·wr- ’îš ’eṯ- šō·wr rê·‘ê·hū wā·mêṯ ū·mā·ḵə·rū ’eṯ- haš·šō·wr ha·ḥay wə·ḥā·ṣū ’eṯ- kas·pōw wə·ḡam ’eṯ- ham·mêṯ ye·ḥĕ·ṣūn
verses.literal: If a man’s ox injures his neighbor’s ox and it dies they must sell the live one and divide the proceeds they also must divide the dead animal
verses.literalPt: Se o boi de alguém ferir o boi do seu próximo, e morrer, então se venderá o boi vivo, e o dinheiro dele se repartirá igualmente, e também repartirão entre si o boi morto.

verses.original: א֣וֹ נוֹדַ֗ע כִּ֠י שׁ֣וֹר נַגָּ֥ח הוּא֙ מִתְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמְרֶ֖נּוּ בְּעָלָ֑יו שַׁלֵּ֨ם יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שׁוֹר֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשּׁ֔וֹר וְהַמֵּ֖ת יִֽהְיֶה־ לּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ōw nō·w·ḏa‘ kî šō·wr nag·gāḥ hū mit·tə·mō·wl šil·šōm wə·lō yiš·mə·ren·nū bə·‘ā·lāw šal·lêm yə·šal·lêm šō·wr ta·ḥaṯ haš·šō·wr wə·ham·mêṯ yih·yeh- lōw
verses.literal: But if it was known that the ox had a habit . . . of goring . . . yet its owner failed to restrain it he shall pay full compensation . . . ox for ox and the dead animal will be his
verses.literalPt: Mas se foi notório que aquele boi antes era escorneador, e seu dono não o guardou, certamente pagará boi por boi; porém o morto será seu.
